prompt: How should the counter describe the current P19 stock to another technician?
promptZh: 櫃台現在應如何向另一位技術人員說明 P19 的庫存？

options.text: Two on the shelf, with both usable.
options.whyZh: 可用件確實有兩個，但損壞件未由退貨櫃台受理，仍應計入三個的帳面架上數量。

options.text: Three on the shelf, with all three usable.
options.whyZh: 架上數量仍是三個，但其中一個一發現損壞就應標不可用。

options.text: Three in the shelf count, with only two usable.
options.zh: 架上計三個，但只有兩個可用。
options.whyZh: 資料列出三個 P19；彎端子件須標不可用，但退貨櫃台未受理，仍計入架上數量。

options.text: Four in the shelf count, with only three usable.
options.zh: 架上計四個，但只有三個可用。
options.whyZh: 四個是 P25 的數量，不是 P19；架上總額應為三個。

explanationZh: 資料列出三個 P19；彎端子件須標不可用，但退貨櫃台未受理，仍計入架上數量。
evidence: P19 | thick | lever | 3 / Mark any damaged plug unusable as soon as you find it, but keep it in the shelf count until the return desk accepts it. / Separately, one of the P19 plugs on the shelf has a bent pin. The return desk hasn’t accepted it yet.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Mark any damaged plug unusable as soon as you find it, but keep it in the shelf count until the return desk accepts it.
Separately, one of the P19 plugs on the shelf has a bent pin. The return desk hasn’t accepted it yet.

vocabulary.note: 指接頭中的針型端子歪彎。
